octo-shared.summary_short: Shared octo-cli knowledge: auth, gateway config, output envelopes, universal flags, error handling.

octo-messaging.summary_short: Messaging: send/edit/sync, search, groups and threads, event polling; App Bot is DM-only.

message.send.advice: App Bot can only DM. This op has no idempotency key, so confirm non-delivery before retrying to avoid a duplicate send.

message.card-revisions-clear.advice: Permanently erases the revision history of a card the bot sent; confirm the message and channel first.

thread.delete.advice: Deletes the thread for everyone and cannot be undone; prefer thread.archive unless deletion was explicitly requested.

group.webhook.create.advice: Returns the push token once. Treat it as a credential: hand it to the requester privately, never post it in a chat.

group.webhook.delete.advice: Deletes the webhook and stops all pushes through it; confirm the webhook id with group.webhook.list first.

group.webhook.regenerate.advice: Invalidates the current push token immediately; every integration using it stops until updated.

thread.webhook.create.advice: Returns the push token once. Treat it as a credential: hand it to the requester privately, never post it in a chat.

thread.webhook.delete.advice: Deletes the webhook and stops all pushes through it; confirm the webhook id with thread.webhook.list first.

thread.webhook.regenerate.advice: Invalidates the current push token immediately; every integration using it stops until updated.

octo-files.summary_short: File upload/download and presigned S3 credentials, plus bot housekeeping (register, user-info, space-members).

octo-docs.summary_short: Docs, sheets, whiteboards, and PPT: create and govern, members and sharing, comments and versions.

docs.create.advice: Pick the editable surface with doc_type; an optional Idempotency-Key header dedupes retries.

docs.versions.restore.advice: Restore overwrites the live document with a prior version; confirm the target version id first.

docs.access-requests.approve.advice: Grants the requester a document role; confirm the request and the role with a human owner first.

docs.invites.create.advice: Anyone holding the invite token can join with the given role; share it only with the intended people.

docs.invites.accept.advice: Joins the document as the bot itself with the invite role; only accept tokens the bot was explicitly given.

docs.forward-grant.batch.advice: Grants access to many uids at once and never downgrades; double-check the uid list and role.

docs.raw-import.docx.advice: With X-Octo-Import-Apply true the document content is replaced; omit it to preview the parsed result first.

docs.raw-import.markdown.advice: With X-Octo-Import-Apply true the document content is replaced; omit it to preview the parsed result first.

docs.raw-import.xlsx.advice: Always applies and replaces the sheet content; confirm the target sheet document first.

octo-drive.summary_short: Octo Drive: spaces, folders, upload/download, doc mounts, share links, invites, IM-attachment transfer.

drive.im-transfer.create.advice: The source message is located by the im_group_no/im_channel_type/im_msg_id triple; a wrong value is a lookup miss, not an error.

drive.trash.delete.advice: Permanently deletes the recycle-bin entry; there is no restore afterwards.

octo-html.summary_short: HTML docs (octo-doc): create and govern self-contained interactive HTML, versions, drafts, sharing, comments.

html.publish.advice: idempotency_key is auto-generated when omitted; reusing a key returns the original document rather than publishing new HTML.

html.draft.create.advice: Never invent a slug; the backend derives it. A draft is not visible in the sidebar until promoted.

html.comment.rm.advice: all=1 permanently removes every comment on the document; deleting one comment by id is a soft delete.

octo-loop.summary_short: Octo Loop control plane: tasks, comments, metadata, projects, labels; dispatch to experts and expert-teams.

workspace.member.add.advice: Adds a member or sends an invitation with the given role; confirm the principal and role first.

octo-mail.summary_short: OCTO Agent Mail: read, search, policy-aware sending, draft preparation, delivery status.

mail.message.send_intent.advice: Sending needs an explicit user request and a stable X-Octo-Idempotency-Key (8-200 chars) unique to this exact send intent.

mail.message.reply_draft.advice: Prepares a reply draft; the idempotency key must be stable per intent or duplicate protection is lost.

mail.draft.create_agent.advice: Agent-authored drafts stay in OCTO Web for owner review; sending needs an explicit user request.

octo-marketplace.summary_short: Marketplace plugins: search, install, publish, review, and update Skills, MCP connectors, and Experts/Teams.
